Surface Hierarchy & Depth

Sunken
Surface
The foundational layer.
Raised
Premium Layer
Maximum visibility and depth.

Layers of Meaning

Use semantic elevation to guide users. Surface provides the base, Raised draws focus for interaction, and Sunken creates internal structure.

Surface (Base Material) Clean, stable grounding for content.
Raised (Action Layer) Floating elements that pull focus.
Sunken (Data Blocks) Recessed zones for passive context.
